pages.title: Information retained by the model
pages.text:
Information retained by the model
Mean ﬂow and measured rate determine stroke volume under the repeated-cycle
assumption.
They do not determine a ventricular pressure waveform, valve leakage or a spatial stress
ﬁeld. Those quantities require additional states and observations.
Computational Cardiology Notes 17 / 17
